summary: Nebius Group N.V. (NASDAQ: NBIS) filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing a merger agreement to acquire MagicByte, Inc. (d/b/a Eigen AI Labs). Consideration includes up to approximately $98 million in cash and ~3.8 million Nebius Class A shares, with founders and continuing employees receiving 15% of stock at closing and the remainder vesting over four years. The boards of both companies approved the transaction, which is not subject to Nebius shareholder approval. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including antitrust clearance, and is expected in the coming months. The deal strengthens Nebius's Token Factory inference platform and expands its US presence; watch for regulatory timelines and potential shareholder litigation.
